about_the_game:
The trial version of "Post-Apocalyptic Survivor" includes the following content:

• Provides two playable characters.

• Only two challenge levels are open.

• High-quality weapons are sold by the weapons dealer "Kendo" for different characters.

• When entering the combat level, the character's skills will be displayed.

• In the trial version's combat levels, characters can only acquire an additional six skills.

• The boss zombie will appear in the combat level before the countdown ends.

• Summoned guards will prioritize attacking the boss.

The full version of "Post-Apocalyptic Survivor" will make the following changes:

• Four playable characters will be provided.

• Six challenge levels will be open.

• For different characters, the weapons dealer "Kendo" will sell at least two high-quality weapons, and other merchants will have a chance to sell advanced items.

• When entering the combat level, in addition to the six additional skills, characters can also explore hidden areas in the level to obtain two more skills.

• There will be multiple bosses appearing in the combat levels for players to challenge.

• Hidden characters can be found in the levels to summon more humanoid followers, who will not have the time limit like robot guards.

This is an action role-playing game that incorporates the monster-killing gameplay of "Vampire Survivors", the collection and character-building elements of "Diablo", and combines them with various experiences such as gun shooting and slashing.

In the trial version, players will be able to take on the zombie hordes by playing as two male characters.

At the weapon merchant "Kendo," you can additionally purchase a weapon with special skills. The weapon will vary depending on the characteristics of the character you use. Choose your favorite character and pick up your preferred weapon! This is a game that everyone can easily get started with. Whether you are an experienced gamer or a newcomer, simply move, select, and decide to enjoy the continuous fun of crushing zombies.

You are a lone hero, equipped with various talents and support skills. You can either focus on your favorite character to change their gear and unlock their ultimate abilities. How you combine your equipment and find your own preferred playstyle will be the challenge this post-apocalyptic world presents to everyone.

He is a stoic warrior. He specializes in using katanas, pistols, and assault rifles. By traveling through a rift in time and space, he has gained dark powers, allowing him to wield unique moves with his katana.

He is a wild warrior.and the grenade launcher is his favorite. Only he can use this heavy weapon, and his physical enhancement allows him to fire it in rapid succession.

——Other characters will be available for creation in the full version.

As a small team of close friends, we create the kind of games we love to play and hope to share them with you. If you have any thoughts on the direction of our game design, we look forward to your feedback on our forums or via email. If you’re interested in this game, please add it to your wishlist—it means a lot to us!

content_descriptors.notes: The main objectives of the game are to kill zombies, complete the storyline, and rescue survivors. The game features graphic depictions of heavy bleeding from the zombies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2060
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: You are a survivor of the "Alpha" project and the savior of this post-apocalyptic world. Amidst the piles of corpses, search for weapons that suit you. For the future of humanity, eliminate these zombies and save our homeland.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
